sentence: This project builds computer tools that read medical records to measure chronic pain and predict which older rural adults with pain may develop depression.
This project studies how transcription factors and genomic sequences control the activation of genes that drive cancer in human cells.
This project studies how changes in a heart muscle protein disrupt its partners and whether delivering the normal protein by gene therapy can reverse this.
This project uses daily surveys of college men to study what raises or lowers the risk of sexually aggressive behavior linked to alcohol.
This project studies how a fusion gene in a rare liver cancer disrupts mitochondria and lysosomes and changes how tumor cells use energy.
This project tests whether a voice-assisted system that tracks symptoms at home can reduce differences in recovery between patients after gastrointestinal cancer surgery.
This project tests a molecular test that detects many metabolic markers to diagnose thyroid biopsies and help patients avoid unnecessary surgery.
This project studies how long noncoding RNAs affect inflammation and atherosclerosis in cardiovascular disease.
This project studies how the surroundings inside cells shape the way tau clumps together in Alzheimer's disease and related disorders.
This project uses brain organoids to find out what causes human neurological disorders and to develop ways to treat them.
This project builds a sensing system for extracellular vesicles that measures protein and RNA markers to track how ovarian cancer responds to treatment.
This project coordinates a research program on the genetics of tuberculosis and oversees its data and resources.
This project builds a portable scanner that corrects for motion in real time to help find small tumors in head and neck cancer.
This project builds resources for publicly sharing B-cell receptor sequencing data and antibody data from studies of HIV vaccines.
This project uses bioinformatics to design a vaccine against periodontal disease.
This project builds advanced mouse models of human disease to speed up how genetic discoveries are turned into treatments.
This project builds a method to turn down gene expression in cultured malaria parasites and studies how the parasites avoid the immune response.
This project develops an oral immunotherapy to prevent Clostridioides difficile infection and its spread.
This project supports translational immune research and therapies.
This project builds AI tools that use digital clock drawing tests to spot early signs of cognitive impairment in Alzheimer's disease and related dementias.
